rules.adapter_bug_fixes: permitted only when they do not change corpus, generated semantic rules, or runtime configuration semantics
rules.authored_evidence: exactly the same four training utterances per intent
rules.fallback: adapter-level or one final catch-all is permitted only to express no-match as BENCH:FALLBACK
rules.translation: mechanical; no system-specific synonyms, wildcard intent rules, concepts, sets, maps, redirects, or added paraphrases
